_what: V3 trained-best-response pool: opponents a candidate must beat on a bed. Interface registry only; runnable_here means trainable end-to-end on this box today with code already in the repo.
_fla_check: python -c "import fla" -> ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fla'; pip show flash-linear-attention -> not found
_citations: No paper was fetched for this registry. GDN 2412.06464 and PaTH 2505.16381 match ids already in the repo (tests/foreman/phase_j/L1/chase_rivals/SOURCES.txt lists GDN and DeltaProduct as [U] not opened); FoX 2503.02130 is the id arms_j.py uses; ALiBi, RoFormer and DeltaProduct ids/authors are from memory and UNVERIFIED -- fetch before citing.

_beds.lm_tinystories_d4x5: byte-level TinyStories LM, design4x5 grid shape (hidden 128, 3 layers, 8 heads, seq 512, batch 8, 3538 steps, CRN split seeds), eval via r3_eval.train_with_eval
_beds.a5_word_T16: A5 word problem bed, sun/daedalus/registry/bars.json beds.a5_word_T16; arms in tests/foreman/phase_j/a5_bed.py
_beds.planning_consequence: planning / executed-outcome consequence beds (none registered in bars.json yet)

pool.name: a
pool.kind: softmax twin, absolute position table (SDPA, is_causal)

pool.name: a_alibi
pool.kind: softmax twin + ALiBi bias -slope_h*(i-j), slopes 2^(-8h/H); zero extra params; strongest zero-param control per Phase J (R-POS)
pool.source: Press, Smith, Lewis 2021, ALiBi (arXiv 2108.12409); tests/foreman/phase_j/RECORD_N.md R-POS

pool.name: a_rope
pool.kind: softmax twin + RoPE on q,k (rotate-half, base 10000); zero extra params
pool.source: Su et al. 2021, RoFormer (arXiv 2104.09864); tests/foreman/phase_j/RECORD_N.md R-POS

pool.name: a2F
pool.kind: Forgetting Transformer twin: per-head data-dependent forget gate as softmax score bias sum log sigmoid(forget_head(x)); +3,096 params
pool.source: Lin et al. 2025, Forgetting Transformer (arXiv 2503.02130); tests/foreman/phase_j/record.jsonl R-FoX

pool.name: gated_deltanet
pool.kind: linear-attention recurrence with gated delta rule (decay alpha, write strength beta)
pool.source: Yang, Kautz, Hatamizadeh 2024, Gated Delta Networks (arXiv 2412.06464); flash-linear-attention (fla) not installed

pool.name: deltaproduct
pool.kind: DeltaNet with n_h Householder products per token (diagonal-plus-low-rank state transition)
pool.source: Siems et al. 2025, DeltaProduct (arXiv 2502.10297); fla not installed

pool.name: path_attention
pool.kind: softmax attention with data-dependent accumulated Householder position encoding (PaTH)
pool.source: Yang et al. 2025, PaTH attention (arXiv 2505.16381); fla not installed

pool.name: d_jepa
pool.kind: latent world model with a bounded permutation-equivariant operator aligned to executed-outcome rankings
pool.source: arXiv 2609.24749, Liu et al. 21 Sep 2026; fetched by Wilson
